But instead of pulling at the chin he pulls with his nails at his opponent’s forehead trying to bring blood.) Ground Moves =1= Over Easy (Vilas sets his opponent up for a normal belly to back suplex but instead does a reverse German Suplex onto his opponents face, chin and chest.) =2= Triple Threat (2 Belly to Belly Suplex’s in a row then a belly to back suplex to finish.)
tenures.bio:
Vilas Lavagna grew up in a normal house, with a normal family and normal friends. Life went as usual for Vilas and things really didn’t get to him. School was no trouble and he usually got high marks when he was interested in the subject. But that’s really where it all ended. 



Vilas parents where very religious people and took Vilas to church every week. At first when he was younger he thought he had to go. But as the story went on Vilas started to question what was being said. Should he praise some over powering being that no one has seen? Should he give all his free moments to the church? She he say his prayers every night and hope for them to be answered?



Vilas didn’t agree with what was being told. He didn’t believe in god, or in fate. He wanted to control his own life and not have something do it for him. His parents at first thought it was just a phase he was going through. But after months of questioning everything that was being said in church his parents finally had a long conversation with him. The told him that he had to believe in the great power or he wouldn’t move onto another life.



Vilas at the time didn’t really care of the next life because he was still very young. For months he argued with his parents about everything he was being told. He would continually ask if anything is the world was real or was it all just made up. 



With that notion, Vilas parents quickly went to see the church and get an answer. They said he was possessed by the devil and must leave if they wanted to get into heaven. So without any thought Vilas parents told Vilas to leave at the age of 14. Vilas did as they wish saying he couldn’t live with people brainwashed by a system. 



Vilas travels brought him to Japan. Of course he couldn’t escape the religions there but he put up with them. There in Japan he started his own group of people who much like him shared the same values as he. Named the realist they quickly gained in numbers. People finally came out and spoke freely about their beliefs. 



But some people couldn’t live with them. So they naturally destroyed there meeting places and punished members whom where involved. Vilas was a major target but went into hiding once members started to be killed off. During that time Vilas trained himself and others in a type of submission martial arts. One of their members was skilled in this art and shared it with the group just in case. 



With no meeting place and members killed, financial problems started to occur. They couldn’t afford to leave. So Vilas ended the group and told everyone to use their skills and use them for good. But try and get your message across. Most of them didn’t. They just went back to the normal system. 



But a few managed to get into some martial arts tournaments and other fighting leagues around the world. Vilas on the other hand stayed in Japan and worked for a small puroese wrestling promotion and used his submission moves to get an advantage over other competitors. He grew in popularity but like always he was forced to leave when his beliefs where told to everyone. 



So now Vilas is again alone and looking. He still will not give up his realistic ideas and beliefs and will work for anyone caught in the system. His main objective is to find more who believe the same and form an even stronger group then before and maybe re-call his old friends back. He doesn’t want to scare anyone but only get his point across. He has been mistaken for a gothic man or a Satan follower but even that isn’t one of his beliefs.  But as of now he is out on his own. Out for respect and pride for his own opinions
catchphrases: "Do what is you need to get ahead, not what someone else wants you to do."

As they are down, Amber throws several types of strikes to the head, be it punches or kicks. with her opponent dazed, Amber crosses to the other side of the ring and makes a claw with her hand, before cutting the air with it, as a taunt to signal the end is near. Amber shows great speed by quickly tearing across the ring, and jumps low from the ground, able to get to the same height as her kneeling opponent. She stretches her legs outward in front of her, and uses her left leg and kick the opponent's head the opposite way, and letting her right leg, or knee area strike their head, taking them out easily. December 17th, 1970 will be remembered as the day that Jason Winn Arawn was born in Seattle, Washington.  His father was Sean Arawn, his mother Christy Arawn.  Sean worked as a judge, Christy worked at home.

At the age of 12, Jason had got his first glimpse of wrestling entertainment.  He was simply amazed.  He had seen all the muscles, and that is when he decided to take action.  He wanted to have a body, just like the men on television.  By the time Jason was 14, he was fit.  He wouldn't stop though, as he kept training.



Jason would join little wrestling promotions, and by the age of 32, he wanted to get into bigger federations.  That is when he joined Primetime Wrestling Academy, with his mother and father supporting him all the way.  Jason was a wild man in PWA, and after seeing some of his work, PURE President Sean Williams signed Jason.  Jason was overjoyed, perhaps too overjoyed.  He was easily eliminated on the first PURE card, Gekito...



...Jason has calmed down, and he has his mother and father supporting him...

signature_moves: As his style dictates, Isao’s move set borrows largely from standard Puroresu, but shines best in terms of his high-flying repertoire. Tribute Moves: “Tiger’s Claw” - Isao applies front face lock on the victim. He then lifts them up by their head and neck and falls back, snapping the victim over onto their back. (Ganso Tiger Driver – Tiger Mask Tribute) “Heaven & Earth” - Isao stands face to face with the victim, slightly to one side. Isao grabs the victim and steps behind their near leg with his one foot. He then uses his arm in front of the victim's chest to push the victim's upper-body backwards while leg sweeping out the victim's leg by pushing it towards his back. This is done in one motion; Isao leans forward and uses the reverse action of pushing the victim forward while sweeping out their leg to take them down. (Space Tornado Ogawa – Naoya Ogawa Tribute) “Specialty” – Isao handsprings then jumps (sometimes out of the ring), doing a backflip before impacting with the victim, knocking them down to the ground at an angle. (Sasuke Special – Great Sasuke Tribute) “Bloody Tiger” - Isao handsprings out of the ring and knocks the victim down at an angle. (Flying Space Tiger Attack – Tiger Mask Tribute) Grappling Moves: “Punch Card” - Isao lifts up the victim as if he is going to body slam them. He then positions the victim's head down and body to his side and then sits/jumps/drops down, dropping the victim on their head. “Quota” - Isao applies a half-nelson while facing the victim. Once applied, he lifts the victim up and falls backwards, dropping the victim over onto their face. “Lay Off” – Isao lands two German Suplexes on the victim before applying a Wakigatame Armbar. “Cutbacks” – Isao nails a German Suplex, holds for the bridge, but then rolls overtop to the other side of the victim. He then pulls them by a reverse waistlock only to send them back down with a Wheelbarrow Facebuster. Striking Moves: “Liability Suit” – Isao executes standard Flash Magic attack, but lifts his knee straight into their nose and backflip to a stance at the victim's feet. “Shipping & Handling” - Isao turns 360 degrees and hits the victim in the head with the heel of the leg which turned first. “Supply & Demand” - Isao does a forward somersault roll. As he rolls forward, he hits the victim in the head/chest with the back of his heel/leg. Submission Moves: “Red Tape” – Isao does a headstand against a standing victim, pulling the victim’s arms to help support his neck against his victim's body weight while using his feet to push the head and neck farther than they're designed to go. “Anti-Trust” – Isao executes a standing Double Chickenwing on his victim and holds it while dropping backwards into a Knee-to-Back Rack. “Hostile Takeover” – Isao executes a Double Chickenwing on the victim, but springboards into a modified version of his Deadline set-up maneuver. Aerial Moves: “Upper-Class Warfare” – Isao executes a Twisting Moonsault Stomp on a downed victim’s chest, landing with his arms folded over chest. “Falling Stock” - Isao jumps over the victim, twisting mid-air and lands back first on them, basically a Twisting Senton.
tenures.bio:
Isao Asai was born and raised in Tokyo, one of the world's biggest cities, and so he has become accustomed to it's constant ebb and flow of change.



He lived a life identical to most middle-class children in 70's Japan, and didn't really blossom as an individual until he got into the field of business, a profession he shared with his father.



Here he spent the next decade of his life, becoming a dynamo in the field of consumer electronics. He had upper management written all over him, his future seemed assured, and that's when he 'discovered' wrestling.



It started as just an entertaining way to spend an evening after work, but that single exposure was enough to instill a hunger in him for the sport like nothing he'd known before.



He immediately searched down a trainer, and would alternate between work and training in a delicate balance that nearly cost him both.



Finally, with his training complete, he made the hard decision between the business he'd grown up in, or the business he known he'd been born for. With a heavy but hopeful heart he resigned from the corporate world and immediately started working the Japanese Indy scene.



Even as a rookie he still shined like few others, and immediately was picked up in a contract with the budding PURE franchise, who hoped to capitalize on young, fresh talent.

tenures.bio:
Born in the year, 2599.  Her DNA flows with the traits of the greatest heroes and leaders of the ages.  She was one of 100 embryos that were created in a laboratory by Dr. Peter Caine and transplanted into a hand picked foster mothers.  It was all a government project to create the greatest military force the planet had ever seen.  Stronger, faster, smarter.  99 out of the 100 embryos devleoped into healthy young, male, babies.  However, one was flawed, her's.  Dr. Caine forgot to give her the 'Y' chromosome that would have made her body develop testosterone, instead of estrogen.  At the age of 5, she was plucked from her home and taken into an underground government facility, along with her 'brothers'.  They were all put through very extensive training, which taught them various forms of fighting styles, weaponry, and spy tactics.  Ash and her brothers spent 15 years locked away from society.  However, something was not right with Ashley.  With each passing moment, she became increasingly rebellious.  One fateful day, the force was given a mission and Ashley would not do as instructed.  The executive of the project, nicknamed 'Project Lamda,'ordered her termination.  In the blink of an eye, her brothers turned against her and Ashley was forced to slay many of them before she finally escaped.  

	

For just over a year, Ashley walked the apocalyptic world, fightig against the goverment that created her and stripped the people of their civil rights.  A leader of a famous rebellion group came calling one day.  His scientists had created a time machine, in which they want to use to change the past and Ashley is their only hope.  She agrees and leaps into the portal...

tenures.bio:
<center>Chase Herrera was born July 16, 1979 in Los Angeles, California.  Never tended to by his parents, Chase went when and whenever he pleased to.  Seeing that the attention that he never had gotten from his parents, it led to a bit of depression.  Chase was then out to get any attention he could.  So Chase began to live on the edge of life.  He wanted to live life to its fullest.  He began to do crazy little stunts in front of friends showing off how fearless he had become.  But as a child, the stunts weren't as daring as many things that would be set for him in the future.  As a child, it only started out to be bike tricks, skateboard tricks, etc.



But as he was growing up, it got worse...



By the age of 15, Chase was into dirt bikes, cliff hanging, bungie jumping, and anything that would perhaps get him killed.



Chase then began to get interested in car racing, even though he didn't have his liscense, he was interested in it.  He wanted to do it one day.  Chase had to work to get a learners permit.  How? Well, he and some friends began to get people to pay to see the crazy stunts that Chase would do.  They would split the profits and Chase would soon get his learners and soon moved on to getting his liscense.  Once he did, Chase had to work more if he wanted a car.  Once he had saved up and gotten his car, an addiction for racing had come to him.



Today, at the age of 23, Chase is a wrestler, but is always out there to do the crazy stunts in the ring and out of the ring. 



What will he do next?</center>

They both worked 9 to 9 every day to support their three children, of which Damian was the youngest. Despite the financial problems Damian's early life was relatively happy. He spent most of his time with his grandparents and siblings: Sister Monica, and Brother Shawn. But as time passed, Damian's happiness began to deteriate. His grandfather Jim died of cancer just before Damian's seventh birthday. The pain was horrible for young Damian but even worse for his father. Damian's father became so depressed that he began to just stop working and was soon fired. Alcoholism quickly followed. Damian's father began taking his anger in frustration out on the young child. His grandmother was slowly dying and he rest of his family did nothing to protect Damian. For the first time in his life, Damian was alone. Damian's life slowly went by. And by age eleven he was contemplating suicide. He felt he had no reason to live and that no one who loved him. But one night he found an alternative. He crushed his family's skulls one by one with a hammer. The same hammer he carries around in his trench coat pocket today. He inhaled the sweet, sweet scent of his family's blood and he knew his life was changed forever. He knew his true calling. He was a serial murderer. Cold and heartless. 'Soulless.' Before leaving the house he cut a deep, deep gash on his left hand. He whipped his blood all over the small house. He faked his own death, sorta. He outsmarted everyone, sorta. But still, he had nowhere to go. But would homelessness really be that bad? Damian brought along a blanket and pillow. He stole every meal he eat. A couple of years went by and Damian spent his time educating himself. Around his 14th birthday Damian began to embrace the Neo-Goth subculture. He began robbing people to pay his way into concerts. Around his 15th birthday Damian got a job at a liquor store. He was paid with food and allowed to sleep in the back of the store during the night. But still, he robbed cars and people for cash. His social skills were near nonexistent. He spoke softly and usually just avoided people. But at night, Damian morphed back into his true self. The hammer wielding psycho killer. He created a method, just not enough of one to allow the police to string his murders together. Damian will come across someone in the street. Anyone really. He has no preference. He will follow them home, keeping himself out of view. After he knows where they live he will study them for a weak or two. Than the stalking begins. And finally the murder. Damian soon mastered his trade. Damian's life pretty much consisted of work, school, and murder, not necessarily in that order. Damian got good grades but kept to himself in school. Everyone pretty much left him alone, and those who didn't mysteriously disappeared... Vanished. Never to be seen again. Of course, no one suspected Damian of doing any wrong. The odd, quiet, little Goth kid was incredibly careful about disposing of the bodies. Heh. I remember the first 'bully' Damian killed. You see, Damian was just sitting around, minding his business, listening to some music. Don't remember who, when this kid came up and kicked him in the back of the head.. Damian followed him as he walked home from his friend's house around 11:25 PM. Damian pulled the fuck into an alley. Bashed his skull in with his trusty hammer. He cremated his body. Sometime around his junior year Damian met a girl. No not a girl. A goddess. This green-haired woman came to Damian. And soon, the two fell in love. But neither knew each other’s dark little secret... Of course, Damian is a serial killer. We know that. But this girl, Samantha was 'different' as well. She was a cannibal. Damian found out soon enough and the two became partners in crime, so to speak. Damian murdering, and Samantha feasting upon the carcass. Sure, sometimes Samantha assists Damian with his murders but usually just allows Damian to do what he does best, alone. But Damian needed money. He was about 17 and was growing tired of working at the same damn liquor store. Even if he could steal all the alcohol and smokes he wanted. He quit and went to live with Samantha. It sucked though. She had four roommates. A bunch of stupid whores. Damian wanted to kill them but Samantha strictly forbade it. So Damian needed his own place. He searched for a job, but found none. But one day Damian learned of an underground fighting affiliation. He went into training and in about six months had his first match. He got his face kicked in by some 322-pound behemoth named 'Mug.' But still, Damian got 200 dollars for the match. He had another match and won. Then he got 500 dollars. He found a cheap ass apartment and moved in, bringing Samantha with him. He fought four times a month and made enough money to support himself. After a while, fighting became somewhat stupid. But he still liked the thought of hurting people for money. So he became a wrestler. Even though he had never even seen a wrestling broadcast. He joined PWA and within two weeks was promoted to NTICW. But soon NTICW was closed. So onto CHZ. They closed as well. (Samantha) Manager: Samantha Full Name: Samantha Sarah Jezebel Birthdate: January 22, 1982 Hometown: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania Height: 5'8' Weight: 122 lbs. Entrance Music: 'Land of Rape and Honey' by Ministry Managing/Cheating Tactics: Can be quite aggressive. Will bite an opponent if she sees any sort of opportunity. Holds Damian's leather trench coat which of course contains his hammer. Will hand Damian's hammer to him if requested. Samantha is not at all afraid to enter the ring in competition. Damian has taught her a small amount of wrestling. She usually sticks to a 'Hit and Run' style. Oh yeah, she has mastered the corkscrew as well. She leaps high into the air doing a 450 Degree Flip with a 360 Degree Corkscrew landing in a leg drop) Stigmata (Samantha bounces of the ropes and performs a running 360 Spin Directly into a spear on the standing target) War (Samantha slides between the targets legs and grabs a hold of their nuts. Biography

I don’t know where to begin so I’ll start out with the basics. My name is Akai Nagato and I was born right here in Asahikawa, Hokkaido, Japan. Both of my parents were of Japanese descent; honorable descent might I add, but that didn’t mean a damn thing. In November of 1979 we moved to a small, rural town in northern Maine. The best job my father could get was as a Senior Executive for a small business. The pay wasn’t bad, the living conditions were good, but the hell I had to go through wasn’t worth half of it all.

Growing up, I was the only foreigner in my school, which made me the center of ridicule. Even in the early grades of fourth and fifth, my life was a living hell. I was called a “Jap” and any other type of discriminatory name they could think of. Everyday after school I would have to take the long way, through the woods, so I wouldn’t be jumped and beaten up. My life, at the point, truly sucked. The only good thing out of all of it was the fact that somehow I kept my grades up. I was always at the top of my class and received many academic awards.

When I reached high school, it got even worst. For example, in ninth grade, a Caucasian boy named Steven punched me right in the jaw. For no fucking reason and because he got me off guard, I could barely defend myself. Our math teacher just stood there and watched...bitch. He picked me up and I got one shot in, right to his temple. At that time, the teacher intervened and sent ME to administration. Needless to say I was the one who got suspended.

That was not the only shitty thing about high school. Girls would ask me out then stand me up. My house would be egged and vandalized. My little sister had to be home schooled. I was even pushed down the stairs once...life, for me, SUCKED. I can not count how many times I held a razorblade in my hand and staring at my wrist. Looking for the “sweet spot” that would take me out of this God-awful existence. I hope all those bastards and bitches suffer the same way they made me, somewhere down the line.

College was better because I made sure it was out of the state of Maine. In fact, I landed an academic scholarship at the University of Connecticut where my education helped me out a lot. I had my first girlfriend there, and she had experience almost the same exact putrid youth I did. She was a Vietnamese woman, and she was beautiful. I gave my body to her and she gave me hers. One night of passion was all that I needed to ‘enjoy’ where I was in life. She was my whole world but after college we went our separate ways.

Again, I thought about ending it all because I had nothing to live for anymore. I was sure I would not get a job I was qualified for because of my origin. My family had moved back to Asahikawa and I was now alone. I was now beginning to grow cold, hateful, and emotionless.

I was checking Japanese web sites (dubbed in English because I had not learned the language that should be predominant one) and came across a site for a wrestling organization known as PURE. The site said the federation was aimed at keeping to its roots, and it really got my interested. I mean, I was following professional wrestling throughout college but it wasn’t the same. That was sports-entertainment...this is wrestling. The very bottom of the site read, “wrestlers wanted. Asians are more than welcome, but we will not turn down any ethnicity.”

I booked the first flight I could back to Japan. I signed up, was accepted, and felt this was exactly why I was put on this Earth. I decided to use myself as a character and for my in-ring name...use the word Enmity. Why the name Enmity? Well, that was exactly how I felt about the world and most of the Caucasian race. This was my time to lash out at the world in a very expressive form. It was also a way to show the country of Japan this is where I belong...

After tearing through PURE for a few months, I decided it was time to move on to bigger and better things. Even though I was the first ever Gekito Cup Winner...TokyoPop’s main attraction...was about to kick Blitz’s ass...AND put Jamar Wilson out of commission...PURE was not necessarily the place for me. Well, also, it didn’t look like PURE was going to the top like it had hoped. And me only caring about myself, I wanted to move into a fed that already had a big spot in the wrestling world.

And that is why, my friends, I left PURE and signed a contract with...

RUSH Wrestling...

tenures.bio:
The following is my recollection of my life up to this point in time. But be warned. In this recollection of mine, there may be events of a sexual nature. Nothing of an extremely gross nature I do not think but an event or two which could be viewed as milady disturbing.



If it is felt that the events which I speak of are too disturbing, just fast forward past that particular event or events. I will give proper warning of these so-called ‘disturbing events’ before I tell of them. With that said, let’s begin shall we?



The beginning sounds like a good place to start.



My life began on a day like today.



October Thirteenth, 1981.



Nothing special about the date in which I came into this world, although I was born eighteen days prematurely. I was destined to be born on Halloween, but was born on the unluckiest day of the month of October instead.



The place of my birth is somewhat significant, though. I was born in Honolulu, Hawaii. When most people think about Hawaii they think of three things. Volcanoes, hot looking babes, and surfing. However, there is more to Hawaii that meets the eye, as I have found out later in my life.



I was born with blonde hair and brown eyes.To move on, the first images that I can remember seeing are those of my parents, Alana and Koi Kalani. When I last saw them, they both had dark black hair, with my father's being short and my mom's being long, and brown eyes. 



To my knowledge, my parents were and always have been very devout Catholics. I’ll talk more about the crazy relationship between Catholicism and myself a little bit later.



My parents gave me the name of Malia, which means “the perfect one” in Hawaiian. I happened to be the first and only child in my family, which is a good thing for me because I did not have to fight any brothers or sisters for the attention of my parents.



As a child, I did several acting gigs. I was in several commercials and a movie or two. Unfortunately, my acting jobs kind of dried out once I hit puberty.



Because of my parents’ religious ties, my family would go to mass every week at the local Catholic Church in Honolulu. Though it was kind of boring at first, but I quickly became intrigued with stories of Noah, Moses, David, and Jesus.



I cannot really remember anything else important in my life until the age of nine. And now I should probably stop and take a moment to say that this is where the disturbing set of events begin. Skip past the next couple of portions if you do not wish to know about what is perhaps the most disturbing set of events that I have lived through in my short life.



Now then. This is something I will never say again because it is so embarrassing for me to reveal it just once that I will never do it twice. Starting at around the time in which I was nine years old, one of the priests at the Catholic Church that I went to began to sexually abused me. I really cannot go into graphic detail because it is just too much for me to reveal. I refuse to say who the priest is because I was told by him that if I ever told that he would kill myself and the rest of my family. Unfortunately, there was no way I could stop him from abusing me sexually. This kept going on until I turned seventeen. Those are the disturbing set of events which I went though.



At seventeen, I became pregnant. Of course, I never told my parents who really had gotten me pregnant. I told them that it was my boyfriend at the time who got me pregnant. They never asked any more questions about the father of the child and the boyfriend just went on with his life.



Anyway, the baby was born on the February Twenty-Second, 1999. When he was born I gave him the name of Keoki, which means “George” in Hawaiian. He looked just like his father the first time I saw him and still does. I absolutely hate his father for what he did to me. However, don’t hate my son one bit for the actions of his father. I always have and will continue to love my son no matter what he or his father does or has done, whether it be to me or anyone else. Sure, he looks just like his father but I love him nonetheless.



Soon after he was born, I began to take an active interest in wrestling professionally. I had enjoyed watching it as a girl. I had stopped watching it for several years because I basically grew out of it for awhile plus I was too busy with acting. But after Keoki was born, I began to watch it again and my interest in wrestling was rekindled.



Once I turned twenty one, I decided to leave Hawaii for good and take Keoki with me. We have not returned since then. There just was not anything there for me anymore. Plus, I kind of felt as if I should get as far away from my terrible past as I possibly could.



So I got on a flight to Tokyo, Japan of all places. It seemed like a mecca of wrestling to me and a great place to start out in the occupation. It has produced many of professional wrestling’s most talented wrestlers over the years.



Since moving to Tokyo, I have tried to put my disturbing past behind me. I legally changed the names of myself and my son. We are no longer Malia and Keoki Kalani. We are now Hoshi and Renzo Akagawa.



Once in Tokyo, I found a place to live and began training long and hard in both wrestling and martial arts. I’ve also tried to get back into acting. In any case, that’s basically where I currently stand as of today, December Twenty-Second, 2002. Where will I go and what will I do in the future? Only time will tell...



Appearance



Hoshi has light skin, long legs, and is a little busty (I guess think Leia Meow except legs that are a bit longer). She has wavy black hair that extends down to around the middle of her back, brown eyes, and pouty red lips. For comfort reasons, she wears a blue sports bra with yellow stars over the breasts, short blue shorts, and blue tennis shoes during her matches. Outside the ring, she wears a black jacket with a white shirt underneath, a short black skirt, and black high heeled shoes.

tenures.bio:
Ilan’s childhood was that of a normal upper class Long Island boy.  His entire family was Jewish and sometimes he thought of them as if they should all be on a TV sitcom.  He has an older brother who always shows off, a younger sister who is more superficial than anyone ever, a mother who cuddles and loves and cooks, and a father who doesn’t speak much, but always has a lot on his mind.



He grew up easily, always getting many good grades in school and having normal friends and girlfriends.  Just your average kid.  Played a few sports, wrestling and baseball, and really just enjoyed his time from birth to age eighteen in the suburbs of New York City.



Then he went off to college, Columbia University in New York City.  He made four friends very quickly and they had been attached throughout their college careers.  Ilan, Roland, Oliver, Pat, and Jimmy were soon known around campus as The Huddled Ones for always being together.  In college Ilan got himself very good grades once again and decided to major in finance his Junior year.  He was going to go into the field of Investment Banking once out of college.



However, there was a small wrinkle in the plan.  After just over three years of college in 2001 The Huddled Ones decided to go see a wrestling show.  They left with their lives changed and decided to join a wrestling school.



In the school they all did decently at first, but then, one by one they quit.  None were fired or thrown out, just couldn’t deal with it for some reason.  At least, all of them except Ilan Levin.  



Ilan graduated from Columbia and Crypt’s School of Wrestling well in both.  He then set off over the summer to train and get experience in Mexico as a Luchadore.  Throughout his time in Mexico he was ridiculed and laughed at.  A Jewish wrestler, now there was a laugh and a half.  However, once Ilan truly showed off his submission skills and his agility people seemed to gradually quiet.  In August he was dubbed, “The Jewserweight” and is damn proud to be one of the very few Jewish wrestlers in pro wrestling.



After garnering skills in Mexico he decided to move onto the next great wrestling capital of the world.  He’d started his career in Manhattan, then moved onto Mexico, now it’s time to try out Japan.  God speed.

Kwan took care of his self for a few years until he was old enough to go out and look for a job, and this is where all the fun started. He was hired by an asian man by the name of Lee. Lee took care of Hwao from there on and took him to Japan where Hwao was introduced to Shotokan Karate, a powerful type of Martial Arts. During his training Kwan entered a Martial Arts tournment. He made it into the semi-finals and he was eliminated after he was Poisoned by one of the fighters. Kwan gained a Disease after the poison and he suddenly became blind in the right eye, and that is why it is red today. But the blindness didn't make Kwan any weaker, in fact he bacame stronger. He gained a power that he didn't have and he hated the world for it. Lee claimed Kwan as his son. From there on Lee sent Kwan out to do all his dirty work such as kidnapping, killing and stealing and this was just the begining of how Kwan became the demon he is.

tenures.bio:
Edward Mandrake was born in the quiet town of Guelph, Ontario to a well-to-do family. He had a good life, with many friends. Quite the popular person, in school. Elementary school proved that he was ranked within the 'genius' category, and was sent to the 'gifted' program at his school. That kind of alienated him from the rest, some were jealous and picked on him, but he was still popular enough to have back up.

He entered High School, still a genius, and of course, he flew through all the advanced courses that he was given, and graduated with High Honors. He got employed at a local home improvement warehouse as a lot attendant (More affectionately known as a Buggy Bitch). He worked there for another two years, trying to build up the funds for college. However, one day, he was being a safety spotter for a forklift driver as he was pulling down some lumber. A nine-year old ran in the way of the forklift, Eddie ran into the zone and halted the forklift. Several loose boards fell off of the lift. The avoided the little kid, but clobbered Eddie right in the head, rendering him unconscious.

When he awoke, he was surrounded by family and friends. However, he felt different. His behaviour changed slightly. Like his watching and reading of dark comedies. Before the accident, he liked the more intelligent comedies. He now enjoyed watching people getting into accidents, getting hurt, and getting killed. It almost seemed euphoric. His parents were worried, and sent him to a shrink to find out what his problem was. Turns out the more recessive personality surfaced when his noggin got a floggin'. The plank of lumber acted as 'Jekyll's Potion'. When he returned to work, he didn't care about safety, either for other customers, or himself. He was fired when he decided to ride a quarter-pallet jack as a scooter through an area cordoned off due to heavy equipment being used. His lust for pain and suffering was evident when he castrated the man who his girlfriend cheated on with, with an olive fork.

After about six months of this behavior, Eddie moved out on his own. He makes a living taking out ads for his services as a bounty hunter in several underground magazines. His method has grown much worse since his, what you would call humble beginnings. He likes to take prisoners, and decorate his hiding place with the body parts of his competitors in the bounty hunter market. His targets are usually skinned alive and sent to the bottom of Lake Ontario. However, it is time for him to select a new career, as the prices are beginning to increase significantly.

The new career involved pro wrestling, where he could still practice his lethal craft, on a non-lethal level. He Entered PCW with hopes of eliminating other people and get away with it, legally! So enteres with very little pomp and circumstance, and most of his time there was rather quiet...even winning the PCW Cruiserweight Championship didn't increase his heat! Eventually, he ended up in limbo within the storylines, so PCW Kingpin Xavier Kannon suggested a tour with the Japanese Fed PURE. Eddie readily accepted to build his pro wrestling reputation. Later that week, he packed his shit, said good-bye to his manager in North America, Spider, and moved to Osaka.

tenures.bio:
In 1974 Muto's father moved to America, more specifically to the Bronx, with his wife, in search of a better life. He quickly established hismelf a small market shop in one of the roughest area's of the city.



Then in 1978 his wife gave birth to a boy, they named him Junzo Muto. They cared for him a great deal and taught him Japanese cultures so that the boy wouldn't be fully corrupted by American society. He learned all of the religious aspects of his native land, the wisdom of his native land, and most importantly the very delicate art of fighting. He was tauight various different varieties of the Martial Arts, which he found constant use for as a boy growing up in the Bronx.



Then in 1988 when Junzo was 10 years of age, his mother and father were killed. He was told that muggers probably did it, but the police had no idea, they found the lifeless bodies of his parents lying in the back alley's. So he was now alone in world.



Junzo couldn't quite remember how the Crimelord Dane Lochlan found him, but his was a relief of sorts. Dane brought him up from 10 onwards, encouraging Junzo to follow the learning of the Martial Arts, whilst secretly training him for another use.



Junzo knew over seven different types of Martial Arts and at the age of 18 Dane announced his plans for the boy. Dne wanted him to be the organisations leading hitman, something to make all of the other gangs and similar organisations could be afraid. Junzo was reluctant to take teh role initially, but felt that he owed Dane for finding him all of those years ago nd raising him to be his own.



And so his path was set for ever more, until one of Junzo's targets was an independent wrestler working the local scene. Junzo melded into the company, under the guise of a new trainee and began to train to be a wrestler, secretly undercover, waiting for the right moment to strike his opponent down. Whilst training, he found a great admiration for the sport and athletism. Junzo still took care of his target, but secretly continued to train, not to Dane's knowledge. When he was fully trained he wrestled under the assumed name of Junzo Muto and wore a mask. And so the story continues...

caption: A Bronx-raised heel taught the martial arts by a father later murdered alongside his mother, Junzo Muto brawled and cheated in equal measure and finished with the Lightening Kick.

signature_moves: Setting Of The Red Sun - Naoki twists the arm of his opponent then climbs the turnbuckle in one of the corner and walks across the ropes so he is directly in between the two opposite posts he then bounces up and on the way down off the ropes he DDTs his opponent head first into the mat while still holding on to their arm with his other hand. Stairway To Heaven - Naoki sets his opponent sitting on the top turnbuckle in one of the corners, he then runs to the corner located right across the ring diagonally from the one his opponent is on and he turns to face his opponent. Naoki runs towards his opponent and as he reaches the corner he springs off the second rope to the right of his opponent and delivers a shining wizard kick to the side of their head making them either fall face first to the mat or sending them falling to the arena floor. Fujimoto Flash - Naoki lifts his opponent up into a hanging vertical suplex he then spins around quickly 720 degrees then sits out while bring his opponent down slamming them face first in a reverse falcon arrow driver. (alternate finisher)
tenures.bio:
For many generations the Fujimoto family have been known for their ninjitsu heritage. Ninjitsu starting nearly 800 years ago the Fujimoto family have come a long way since then and with each new generation the legacy is past on from father to son. However that was not the case when it came to Hiro Fujimoto and his father Takata. Hiro was more of a modern man in society and saw the art of ninjitsu as nothing but a waste of time. He was more worried about getting through life successfully rather then having the knowledge of the ninja. So it was with much rebellion that he defied his father’s wishes and went on to live an average citizen’s life. 



	As the years went by Hiro had become quite the success story as he  became co-owner of a hug software company. He was making large amounts of yen and he had his decision to focus mainly on school and everyday life rather then listening to his father’s ramblings of the ninja to thank for it. If that wasn’t great enough already he had also fallen in love with a beautiful woman he had been dating since university, Chika Goto. The two love birds would be wed and much to the disgust of Takata he was happy for his son. Hiro had made all the right choices and he had big plans to start a family and raise his children the way he had grew up, he was in for a big surprise.



	On August 26, 1976, Hiro’s wife Chika would give birth to a healthy baby boy who weighed in at nine pounds and three ounces. Hiro was overcome with joy at the birth of his first son and he knew that his son would go on to be just as successful as him one day. The happy couple named their son Naoki after Chika’s deceased uncle who had died just a few months earlier in a car wreck. Takata was also present at the birth of his grandson and when he first held him he knew that young Naoki would indeed be successful but not in the way his father planned.



	Takata made it possible so that he would spend a lot of his time with Naoki as he grew up. Hiro was usually busy at work and Chika also had a part time designing cakes and pastries for parties and special events. She did all this  right from her very own kitchen of the large house that Hiro was able to buy in Tokyo, Japan where all the big business was. So often when Chika became too busy she would leave Naoki with his grandfather, how was she suppose to know that a warrior was in the making right under her very own nose?



	Having lost his chance with his own son Takata was determined to pass on the legacy of ninjitsu to Fujimoto blood and lucky Naoki was “the chosen one” so to speak. Takata trained him from the time he took his first step and although the training started out pretty gentle it would get more harsh and challenging as Naoki grew. When Naoki was old enough his parents sent him to one of the best schools in the city but Naoki never did speak a word of his ninjitsu training. He would go to school and study very hard then after school he would head on over to his grandfather’s to resume last night’s training. 



	Naoki was never a very popular kid in class nor did he ever try to be. He liked to keep to himself and he would rarely speak. Most of this came from his grandfather’s training in that a ninja is very stealthy and only the weak draw attention to themselves. Naoki was a very smart boy however and he did well in school thanks to his parent’s money and his great attention span. Both his parents would find out what he was up to after school when Naoki turned ten and his father was shocked beyond belief. Hiro’s own father had been training his son in the art of ninjitsu behind his back for ten whole years. Although Naoki did well in school he was very passionate of keeping up with his training and against his father’s wishes he wanted to grow up to be a ninja just like his grandfather. He stayed in school though so he kept his parent’s happy but he bled the blood of a ninja.



	As Naoki got into his teens his training sessions with his grandfather became more intense and more physical. Often returning home with many cuts, sores and bruises from head to toe. In high school he remained the mysterious, silent kid and because of that he was often flocked by girls who were turned on by his persona. Lucky for the other single guys though Naoki did not let female flesh detain him from his studies and his training. Around this time on January 14, 1992 Naoki’s mother would give birth to his little sister, Mai. Naoki cared very much for his sister and always kept a close eye on her. Naoki continued on with his training and even began fighting in tournaments with his grandfather in his corner. 



	Naoki grew stronger and stronger and after high school at the age of eighteen he had left school to permanently focus on his training and tournaments. Mai was now attending the same school Naoki first started out in and Hiro and Chika were happy that at least one of their kids were following the plans they had in store. Naoki’s grandfather grew weak in age so he stepped down from physical training and just mentored Naoki on his mind and mental abilities. Naoki would train against other fighters each week at the martial art dojo just outside of town. Mai would sometimes come to watch her brother as well as both  Naoki’s mother and father who had come to accept the life he chose even though they would still favour he would get a real job.



	On September 28, 1996, a few weeks after Naoki’s twentieth birthday Takata, Naoki’s grandfather would die in his sleep from a heart attack. Naoki was of course deep down sad but he never let his feelings get in the way of his training as his grandfather taught him. He trained harder and faster and no doubt he had surpassed his grandfather in skill. He had pretty much mastered both physical and mental aspects of a ninja at such a young age and his grandfather’s dream was met, the legacy was handed over. Naoki continued to train and earn money in tournaments. He eventually raised enough to buy himself a small apartment in Mishima, Japan but he couldn’t continue living like this. Sure he was making money but barely enough to fully live off of. He needed a job but he did not want to abandon his training.



	Thus on January 4, 1997, he came across pro-wrestling. A wrestler could make pretty good money, even more then a ninja down on his luck. This would also allow Naoki to keep up with his training and earn better money to support himself as well. For the next five years Naoki trained in a wrestling dojo and did a few smalls shows now and then for both fighting and wrestling to keep the cash flow going at least. After his five years of wrestling he was brought into his first federation on March 16, 2002. The Mishima Wrestling Alliance was a regional federation right in his very own hometown and it was very convenient for him. Naoki had since learned most of the basic moves of wrestling as well as some amazing high flying spots that he could pull off with ease. Ninjitsu was still his base though and it showed in all of his matches. He was one of the most talented workers on the roster. 



	In the May of 2002 Naoki would come to meet Nicolas Grimes. Nicolas Grimes was originally a wrestler himself born in Salt Lake City, Utah of the U.S.A. Naoki found himself in a heated feud with this gaijin. Naoki was far more superior in skill then Grimes. Nicolas however was very charismatic and came off very arrogant whenever around someone. He often gloated about himself but once in the ring with Naoki he was quickly silenced with a swift kick to the jaw. Naoki got the pin fall ten seconds into the match making it the quickest match in MWA history. Naoki could not stand Grimes and he was just glad that he jus shut the white boy up for good.



	However fate would play against Naoki as the booker found the duo of Naoki and Nicolas Grimes to be quite the pair. He enjoyed their stint together so much as enemies that he actually made Nicolas Grimes Naoki’s manager and moth piece as Naoki was still his old quiet self. Naoki was not very impressed but he did not bother to argue as he had more important things to worry about so he was forced to tolerate the annoying presence of Nicolas Grimes. Grimes didn’t know when to keep his big mouth shut though and he would often get the two into trouble which Naoki would have to get them out of. Grimes was more of a liability then help but Naoki kept quiet. Naoki would go on to capture the MWA World Heavyweight Title in July and would hold the belt until the MWA eventually went bankrupt in October.



	Naoki was now desperate for work once again but he thought he would go on a more global basis. So Naoki went back to Tokyo for a month to visit his family and then he boarded a plane and flew to North America. Unlucky for him Nicolas Grimes decided to tag along to return to his homeland. Naoki had studied some English in school so he was fluent in the language but he still kept quiet. For the next few months Naoki and Nicolas Grimes would appear in random federations and wrestle matches for them all. This continued into 2003 until eventually both Naoki and Nicolas Grimes returned to Japan in January. A new federation had caught Naoki’s eye though, Puroresu Ultimate Ring Entertainment or better known as PURE. A much larger company then the MWA and with even more skilled athletes that Naoki could test himself against. Nicolas Grimes got into negotiations with some of the PURE staff and was able to get an interview with the PURE owner,  Mr. Jamar Wilson himself. Mr. Wilson was indeed impressed with Naoki and within a few short weeks Naoki found himself backstage a PURE event taping up his fists.



	Now finally in PURE Naoki hopes to test himself against the best PURE has to offer him in the ring while Nicolas Grimes is blinded by the stardom and merchandise. Will Naoki fit in within these new surroundings or will he find himself in troubled situations? It is all downhill from here.

tenures.bio:
Orlando Scott Bio



************************************************

Make this a rule, before you have a child, you must have the proper finances before delivering a child into the world. On April 15th/1978, A young couple that went by the names of Stephen Scott and Abby Moore. It was a sea section surgery, which lasted only thirteen-minutes. They named the young boy Orlando, after Abby’s father. In about three days young Orlando and Abby were released from St. Mary’s hospital in New York. Stephen Scott, the father or Orlando had no attentions on accepting the duties of becoming a father as a teenager, so he parted from Abby. Abby was a strong woman, never complained about anything. Abby and Orlando began their lives at the home of Abby’s parents. A small semi home, which was located in a rough area of New York. Abby kept young Orlando isolated from the outdoors, due to the rough streets of Harlem. 



Orlando showed signs of intelligence young, he was crawling, walking and talking above the expected age. When Orlando was two, he was able to write his own name, which was rare at that age. He became anti-social to the other children on the schoolyard, which came from his father’s side of the family. Abby also never allowed Orlando to associate with any of the neighborhood kids, hoping he will not pick up any bad habits along the way. 



Orlando drifted through school with ease. Never being top of his class, but never being the lowest student. It was not until high school he broke out of his anti-social shell. Orlando was getting a lot of attention from the opposite sex. Orlando based most of his youth years, lifting weights in his grandfather’s weight room, located in the basement of the small home. After several years of working out, his hard work finally had begun to pay off. Orlando’s body was above average, having a great muscular build to show for his hard work. He did not play many sports, but he was always interested in wrestling, which is why he joined the school team. Orlando excelled in wrestling with ease, becoming well known around the school boards, under his weight class. He graduated at the age of eighteen, and decided to not proceed with his education, and stay in town with his girlfriend, and join the navy. 



Life was finally beginning to shift for the young Orlando. He now has his own apartment with his new fiancée, Holly. Both at the age of twenty, they had already achieved their life long goals. Holly was already a nurse, and Orlando was a Navy Seal. Orlando was now a weapon, a weapon not to be used unless in a battle formation. He was living life to his fullest, Holly and Orlando were to be wed the following summer. 



They were joined in holy matrimony on July 21st/1998. They had a child on the way, and their financial situations were doing great, so they decided to move into a small home. A great home to start a young family. The child was born seven months after the wedding. It was a small baby boy, Sebastian. Just when Orlando thought life was perfect, the unexpected occurred. Holly was gunned down at a shooting raid, which was between some bikers. This was above all the worst time for this passing. Young Sebastian was only at the age of two. Orlando and his mother Abby were parting every day, more and more. Orlando and his son Sebastian moved back into a small apartment. Finances were beginning to shift in the opposite direction. Work was fading.



Years passed, with a low budget. The two were able to get by, Orlando expressing all the love he can into his son. The two were very close, Sebastian now hitting the age of six. On that same year, Orlando let his actions get the best of him one night, which costs him his job in the Navy. At a nearby bar, he was surrounded by a pile of drunks, and without thinking, engaged a powerful blow to the opponents neck, making the man a vegetable for his remaining lifetime. Orlando was let off reasonably easy, just the loss of his job, and a short time in prison. 



Orlando now at the age of twenty-four. Orlando and his son Sebastian lived in a small trailer located at the Cedar Ridge Trailer Park. Orlando called it a temporary substitution for the two. But this substitution will be permanent, as Orlando had no attempt of getting a job. Orlando was now only good at one thing, using his body as a weapon, which he believed that time had passed. Although he did not realize there were alternative options to having a skill such as his. Which was brought to his attention by his son, by giving his father a flyer that he received off the Internet from school. He had watched his father at work, and he knew he would become a great professional wrestler, if given the effort. Sebastian knew his father had the physical ability for the game, but the mental ability was still to come.



Another year passed, with the PWA flyer still resting on the coffee stand. At this time, Orlando was tired of unemployment. He wanted a better life for himself and betters yet his son. He had finally applied to the academy, which was granted and he was officially a rookie in professional wrestling. Orlando was still in his muscular build, just needed to rust of the basics. He had prepared for this for a few months, now he has notified the academy he is ready for battle, and only time will tell if this young talent has what it takes.

tenures.bio: Brought up to respect everyone and everything, Padrona began life much quicker then most boys his age. His parents had major goals and morals to set on their son at an early age, and by the age of four he was already starting to lift weights and run miles on end, trying to build his agility and strength. His parents saw this gift as an opportunity not only for them, but also for Padrona to become someone special in the world. They wanted him to use his gift as a way of showing his respect for his family. Padrona started taking martial arts and several other fighting and combat styles attempting to become a very skillful worker. Tournaments came and went, but no loss would keep this young child down. While other opponents got ear full from the trainers, Padrona would come alone and virtually break down his opponent on his own. At the starting of each match he would bow to his opponent in honor, then receive spit to the face or the middle finger. Padrona then moved onto larger competition, where money was involved. He kept his ways going and still received the same treatment. In one incident, he bowed to his opponent and received a stiff kick to the face. So Padrona placed a mask over his face, blocking out the window to the soul. Now his opponents would be fighting with no edge. Family and friends would cheer him on, but never gave more then respect to their son. Money was divided between family, travelling and charities. Padrona was brought up the right way and soon would give over five million dollars to local charities in Thailand. But soon, tragedy would strike, as Padrona’s body started to fade. His wrists started to give out and during one battle he collapsed both his lungs which almost ended his life. For the next five years while his body healed, Padrona studied the world and learned more about culture through out the world. He became interested on how the body works, and rituals of competition countries have. By 1995, Padrona was healed and ready to start again. Armed with a mask, wrist and shin plates and his intelligence, Padrona travels the world in search of new forms of competition. His respect for owners and political leaders has brought him great success. No matter what he is told to do, Padrona will comply as long as the task is honorable. He still gives a great deal to charities and to his family, keeping very little for himself. He now finds himself looked for a new form of honorable competition that the world has yet to see him in. The History of the Mask The mask Padrona wears is said to hide the ability Padrona possesses. In blocks out any mental feeds Padrona might be signaling and also stops eye movement from identifying the direction Padrona will take. The mask was a gift from his father as a child. It is believed to also symbolize the honor and respect Padrona has for his opponents. The mask adds the illusion to a face inside the mask. Padrona will never remove the mask, even out in the normal world. He is said to care so much for the world around him, that not showing his face means a sign of respect to the people around him. He bows to all, and rarely gets over abusive with anyone. The mask also shows that connection between his respect and honor for Thailand. Respect and Honor Padrona’s respect is said to be the key to his success. Respecting his opponent and honoring their method is the first step in learning how they move, think and fight. Padrona knows the world does not respect everyone, but with himself as the role model he tries to push those ways. Padrona’s respect and honor goes as for as to respect his enemies and the greedy at heart. Now one is perfect to him but that is respect is the sign of perfection. Now he looks at all as an equal until other wise. His main goal is to get the respect of his fellow opponents and be seen as a high respectable opponent. Weaknesses Face – Guards his mask at all costs, so his true identity is not reveled. Strength – His low strength can become a fact later on in matches when fatigue sets in. Wrist – Has weak wrists and can’t hold up opponents for long periods of time. Lungs – Weak lungs and can become short of breath quickly Mind – Can over think his strategy and miss key factors or take too long to execute a move. Strengths Arms – Has enough power to lift heavier men in quick motions. Leg's – Strong legs that allow faster movement. Mind – Uses intelligence as a weapon to out think his opponent. Emotional: Padrona style and way of life revolves around honor and respect for his opponent. There will be no trash talking from his mouth, as he prefers to rather defeat his opponent in an honorable fashion. Though he will get violent when need be, Padrona remains calm and collective even in the deepest defeats. He does not allow his emotions to control his actions, takes orders very easily, even if he has negative thoughts about the owner. Cheating is never an option and this may cause some loses if he spends time even thinking about the possibilities. He also is very involved in the culture of Thailand, which adds onto his values. Physical: Padrona uses key aerial moves, plus a large variety of ground base slams to grab an upper advantage. With a smaller size, he is very quick, but also has the power to lift heavier opponents. He takes calculated risks, and if need be, he may go out and take an extreme risk, only if the prizes is worth the risk. He may use his arm and shin plating as weapons during a violent struggle or if his opponent has cheated in a way before. He uses the classic bowing of the head to signify an acceptance.

tenures.bio:
Set Up: Paradox -  Para grabs the arm and Irish whips the opponent, but she pulls back. Then she slides underneath as the opponent comes back, holding the arm and pulling it between his legs, setting up for the Paranoia.



Finisher: Paranoia -  Straight Jacket Clutch Reverse Fisherman Suplex. From behind, Para reaches under hooks the opponent’s right leg and grabs the left arm with the same hooking arm. Then she brings the opponent’s right arm across his left and locks her hips, snapping the opponent over onto his neck and upper spine. Half the time she releases and then makes the pin, and the other half she bridges. 



Upgrade Finisher (super finisher/high impact) Anxiety – Swanton Roll into a Rana Face Driver. If the opponent kicks out of the Paranoia, Para goes to the top rope and clutches her head as she waits for the opponent to get into position. Then with the opponent standing facing her, she flips off with a Swanton Somersault with her arms stretched out in perfect formation. Then as he flips over she lands on the opponent’s shoulders legs first. From there she allows the momentum and gravity to carry her over, her legs locked as she falls back and drives the opponent face first into the mat, she slipping through his legs to pull him down more. After hitting the move she rolls the opponent over onto his back with her legs still around his neck, hooking both legs for the pin. 





Signature moves:



Persistence- Front Shuffle Triple Strike Combination: Paranoia hops forward with a right snap kick into the knee of the opponent, followed by a left kick into the side of the hip, both to stagger the opponent to the right. Then Paranoia comes out with a jumping roundhouse kick to the head, knocking the opponent left onto his side.



Aggression- A Hurricanrana into a Mounted Punch: Para jumps from either a standing position, running, springboard off the ropes, or off the turnbuckle with a hurricanrana. Once flipped over, Para kneels on the opponent and hits him with rights in the face.



Resentment- Flying Cross Block Spin: After whipping the opponent into the ropes Paranoia catches them with a flying cross block to their chest, the impact sending the opponent down and spinning her own body in the air before she lands on her knees.



Annoyance- Springboard Shooting Star Lariat: From the apron Para springs off and nails a back somersault, diving across the ring and coming down with a left clothesline across the throat of the standing opponent. In tag matches often done after the tag from her partner. Can also be done from inside the ring to outside.



Neurotics- Corkscrew Moonsault Axe Kick: Para runs up the corner and flips back with a corkscrew moonsault, twisting around and nailing a hard heel axe kick into the face of the opponent.



Obsession- Overhead Bridged Sleeper Hold: With the opponent face down on the mat Para locks her hands around their neck and flips over, bridging back to back on the opponent. She arches her back to tighten the choke submission.



Intimidation- Throat Clutch Push into a Spinning Lariat: The opponent runs at Para, but she stops him with a tight grip on his throat. Then she shoves him away back first into the ropes, spinning around on her grounded leg and coming back with a knife edged lariat, dropping to her knee from the momentum.



Anarchistic- Windmill DDT Combination: Starting from the top of the corner, Para sets the opponent up for a Tornado DDT. Swinging off, she kicks her legs out in a windmill pattern and DDT’s the opponent. Then she kicks her body over onto her feet and holds the arm, pulling the opponent up again. Then she runs up the ropes and springs off with another windmill DDT. A chain series, done from the corner to the ropes to the other set of ropes and back across the ring again as many times as she desires.







Standard moves: 

Aerial: 450 splash, moonsault (standing, spingboard, tope).

Technical: Falcon Arrow(spinning or standard), German Suplex, Back Drop Driver, Fisherman Suplex.

Power: scoop powerslam, tilt a whirl side slam, falling powerslam (scoop to a horizontal position, then fall forward into a powerslam).

Martial Arts: Roundhouse kicks, Spinning heel kicks, spinning wheel kicks, Tae Kwon Do Spin/reverse kicks.

tenures.bio:
Peter's mother was Irish, and his father Mexican. They were however raised in the Bronx. They never had much, except a warm loving family. Being Roman catholics, they had nine children. Peter was the third youngest, and was also the favourite. He was always extremely smart though never got a chance at college due to his families 'tight budget'. 



Peter had another talent however, fighting. He was extremely skilled at fighting and as well as being strong he was fast and skillful.



Tragedy struck the Perez family as a whole during the heated Harlem vs. Bronx war. Most of the Perez family were involved as all Peter's cousins, uncles, aunts and other relations lived in the area.



Though this war grew to more and soon the Perez family owed New York's biggest gangs alot of money, more than they could imagine. They were all kicked out of their homes. They had to live in an alleyway with only a small warehouse room for shelter. All 47 of the Perez family lived there. They deperately tried to pay off their debts, thought everything they got was only a tiny fraction of what they owed.



Peter's brothers and cousins then began fighting for money, they were all very good and brought home alot of money to the family, though still not nearly enough. That gangs had started using huge interest rates. 



As soon as he was 14, Peter started fighting for money too. He was exceptional, he never even lost until he was 16, when the competition got tougher, he rarely got marks due to his agility and speed. Be then entered bigger fights and won more money.



Soon he started Underground tournaments where the prizes were up to $250,000! Though still only asmall fraction of what his family owed. He then started joining league's and clubs but still he was not making enough! Then, he saw that a new indy wrestling promotion running out of New Jersey, which was not far from Bus, was starting up, he knew he could make alot of money is a place like that. So he applied, praying he would be good enough. And, he was. Well, almost. He was sent to PWC's affiliate promotion in Japan for further evaluation. He knew what he was up against, and knew that he must fight, and win.

signature_moves: Puroresu Wrestling is about Man-To-Man combat. The eternal fight between Good and Evil. Using devasting Technical moves, high impact Aerial moves and bone-breaking Submission moves, Radiant has a plethora of moves at his disposal to finish off his opponent. Tribute Moves “Super Heaven Bomb”- Radiant puts an opponent onto his shoulders, into a Torture Rack, while standing on the second rope of the turnbuckle. (Kenta Kobashi tribute) He spins around in a circle, before pulling the opponent down into Head-Spike Brainbuster. (Also Known as Burning Hammer.) “Golden Space Drop”- After disposing of his opponent, Radiant handspring’s inside the ring into a Moonsault over the ropes to the outside with a twist in mid air. (Great Sasuke tribute) Grappling Moves “Shatei”- Holding the opponent’s around the neck, Radiant runs into the turnbuckle and leaps onto the top rope, pushing himself and the opponent off. When they bounce off, he picks up as if to Tilt-A-Whirl Slam them, but drops them forward in a modified Michinoku Driver. “Tekiya”- With the opponent on the turnbuckle, Radiant ascends the turnbuckle with them and locks their head up in a headlock. Radiant then proceeds to pull the opponent into the air and lands them in the middle of the ring with a Brainbuster. Striking Moves “Gurentai”- After his opponent is downed onto the mat, Radiant awaits for them to get back onto their feet. As they’re doing so, he spins in a circle and slams his elbow into the opponents jaw. “Kumicho Wakashu”- Radiant bends his knee and waits for the opponent to either turn around, or get back on their feet. He takes off in a sprint, and slams his shoulder or head into the opponents stomach, spearing them to the floor. Submission Moves “Bakuto”- With the opponent face down, Radiant takes the arm and pulls it upwards; with the right arm vertical across the wrist and the left bent across at the shoulder and pushing up from underneath the elbow, hitting a deadly Fujiwara Armbar. “Uyoku”- Following the Tekiya, Radiant locks on a headlock on the opponent’s neck. If the right arm is free, Radiant will lock that up arm under the headlock to hyperextend the elbow. Aerial “Hayabusa Special”- Radiant climbs the turnbuckle after taking the opponent down with any move listed. Radiant waits for the right moment, casually encouraging the fans in attendance. He then proceeds to flip off the turnbuckle with a 450 degree rotation, and then splashing on his opponent. (Hayabusa tribute.)
tenures.bio: In The Beginning... On a tiny island, west of the Japanese main island of Honshu, a legacy would begin on the 21st of May 1620. Ichiro Kunamara had been thrown off a small boat housed by a nearly a dozen castaways from the Japanese town of Niigata. Kunamara had befouled the captain’s daughter, taking away her virginity while on a night of drinking through the port-town. The enraged captain, Kintaro Kawashima had ordered Kunamara to be drowned in what today is called the Sea of Japan. Luckily for Ichiro, he had managed to fight off the men of Kintaro Kawashima and float along in the cool Sea of Japan water until he reached an island off in the distance. Kunamara wondered many a night around the island, finding that the small island had plentiful fresh water, trees with fruit on them and several roaming livestock. Ichiro set to work building himself a small home, with the use of a Machete he had stolen from the boat. The construction of his home took Ichiro three solid weeks of construction to build himself a small house for him to sleep in. He had no way of travelling his way back to the mainland, unless he built himself a boat. So, Ichiro Kunamara went to work again. No rest period from between building his new home and constructing the small boat. The trusty Machete he had been using over the last few weeks was lashed into the nearby trees, Ichiro knocking down three trees to build himself the boat. The boat was only big enough to carry him, some food and the Machete. Ichiro set sail back to the main land, but he knew of the dangers lurking in the port-town of Niigata. Ichiro was known by many on the western coast of the main island. So, he had a choice. Ichiro pondered whether or not to arrive into Niigata and battle with the outlaws who had tried to cut his life short, or float South of Niigata toward the newly established Toyama. He decided to travel to Niigata, his life had been lacking excitement recently. It was very early July when Ichiro Kunamara snuck into the quiet town of Niigata, very early in the morning. He would have been very recognizable to the locals if he didn’t disguise himself by stealing a sheet of cloth that hung from the window of a house on the near the jetties. Ichiro tiptoed through Niigata in the dead of the night. He creaked open windows of closed food stalls to steal Bread, Rice, Additional Clothing, Woks for cooking, A couple more Machetes and Knifes, and a bigger boat that was abandoned, but in good condition, on the shores. He went unnoticed on this historical night. Not a soul in the port-town knew about his thieving, and would remain completely oblivious for years to come. Ichiro sailed back to his lonely island as the sun came up, watching the town of Niigata come to life as he floated away peacefully in the Sea of Japan. ...More To Come.
