tenures.bio:
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

Finisher: Shi-ne! --- Raizo lifts the opponent up in his arms with a Bearhug Front Slam, and then KO’s the victim with a hard right hand straight punch to the face, knocking the opponent back on his head and upper back. After delivering the move, Raizo glares at the opponent and growls “SHINE!” 



Second Finisher (super finisher): The Black Market: Raizo applies a front face lock on the victim, hooking the right arm and hoists him up for a vertical suplex. Then with the head and arm cradled, Raizo drops down to the mat in a sitdown elevated cradle piledriver. Will jump into the move to add more impact if necessary, the ultimate version of the Black Market.



:Moves: 



-Over the top rope Floatover Diving Lariat. Raizo runs up the corner and turns in the air, floating over the top rope and nailing the opponent with a diving lariat drop (jumping feet first in a slanted horizontal position) 



-Yakuza Kick. Running or side step from a standing spot.



-Diving Senton off the top rope.



-Rolling Lariat



-Gutwrench Powerbomb



-Underhook Powerbomb



-The Incarceration (Raizo locks on a double chickenwing, crossing the opponent’s wrists over each other in a reverse straightjacket formation. Then he snaps them over onto the back of their head with the suplex. 



-The Saikyoplex (Top Rope high impact move; Raizo sits the opponent on top of the corner facing the crowd. Then he climbs up behind them and locks in a full nelson cobra clutch. Then he falls back, locking his hips and throwing the opponent over onto the back of their heads.)





Submissions.



-Full Nelson Camel Clutch (often will kneel on the opponent’s back for more pain) 

-Full Nelson Cobra Clutch (standing behind opponent)

-Gyakukataebigatame: Half Crab

-Armbar, fujiwara armbar, armbar with choked hold [All from a standard armbar takedown]









Suplexes (Used individually or in chains)



The Crime Spree: The name Raizo gives his chain series of suplexes. 



-Back Drop Suplex

-Belly to Back Cradle Suplex

-Aztec Suplex (Straightjacket Suplex)

-Millennium Suplex (Crossface Chickenwing German)

-Tiger Suplex, Tiger Suplex w/release

-Tequila Sunrise Suplex (Half Nelson Chickenwing Suplex)

-Tazmission Suplex

-German Suplex, Multiple Rolling German Suplexes, Top Rope German (Spider Suplex)

-Blockbuster Suplex

-Dominant Overhead Belly to Belly suplex.

-Cobra Clutch Suplex

-Cradle Suplex, Spinning Cradle Suplex.

-Dragon Suplex, Dragon Suplex w/release

-Leg Capture Suplex

-Snap Suplex, German Snap Suplex, Back Snap Suplex

-Soviet Judo Suplex, Uranage Suplex

-Butterfly Suplex

-Kieru Suplex: Raizo Tenzan applies a half nelson while facing the victim. Once applied, he lifts the victim up and falls backwards, dropping the victim on their head/neck/upper back. This often comes out of nowhere, and when executed to perfection, lands with lots of impact, due to the ‘snapping’ motion of Raizo’s lower body. 

-Suisha Otoshi: Watermill Suplex; looks like a back body drop, but starts out with Raizo tucking his head under the opponent’s arm or in between their legs and scooping them up on his shoulder.















Bio



For every child in the world who grew up in a life of poverty and overcame it, there is a child who grew up in wealth, wishing he were someplace else. Raizo Tenzan was the latter of the previous statement. His family had speculative wealth, well the speculators were often correct. His father was worth more money then most could envisage. Conversely, the origin of this money was far from that of a hard working Japanese citizen. 



Junichi Tenzan, the esteemed and well-respected father of Raizo, was publicly perceived as a hard working businessman, a rags-to-riches story in the Fukuoka community. However, there are much deeper roots to Mr. Junichi Tenzan’s wealth. The roots would leave a scar on Raizo Tenzan’s life, not only as a young child, but it would affect him forever, an eerie shadow that he could never shake.



Junichi Tenzan was the leading director of operations in the largest crime syndicate in Japan. During the year of 1978, the year of Raizo’s birth, Junichi Tenzan was in the midst of the largest scale counterfeit operation in Japanese history. He amassed a small fortune of three million United States Dollars, which he later had deposited in an overseas bank account. This was only the beginning…



Junichi Tenzan would clime the ranks of the crime syndicate, and hoards  millions upon millions of United States dollars. This all ceased, although shortly, when Raizo was born.



Born July 2nd 1978, Raizo Tenzan, he immediately experienced the benefits of living a wealthy life, reaping the benefits of his fathers previous work. He was tutored by a Japanese teacher in the arts of English and

became an articulate and confident speaker in both his mother tongue and English. 



Raizo Tenzan’s life was nothing short of blissful, his earliest years, up to five years old, were spent playing with an abundance of toys and learning the art of Japanese and English. Moreover, it would result in an

abhorrent twist of fate that would inevitably change his life forever. 



From the age of five years and onwards Raizo would only know a world of pain and treachery. His father resumed his work, and Raizo experienced the cruel backlash of fury from his father’s hand. Something his mother must have previously experienced, she died a few days after Raizo was born. Apparently from the pain of child labor…



How much do you trust your own father?



They came and went, they came and died, they came and lived; however, the last clause was a rarity. They say the events that shape your personality, sense of morality and character occur when you are young. In Raizo’s case, he was becoming everything that could be viewed wrong in the world.



He took on a sense of hate and disrespect for anyone he met outside his family. His perception of everything was blinded by obscene rage and hate. It somehow acted as a catalyst on his life. His size escalated above his father, and above the size of the people employed to look after him. Raizo

was becoming a beast. At the age of fifteen, he was already 5’11”, five inches taller then his father.



Every one of the events he witnessed, murder, treachery, deceit and an iron will made Raizo into an unyielding angry man. His teenage years were spent taking vicious beatings from his father, till his fifteenth birthday.



There comes a day in every mans life when he must stand for what he believes in, it just so happened Raizo’s came a bit earlier in his life then most. On his fifteenth birthday, as his father was about to strike

him, Raizo span to his right and smashed his father’s skull through the glass desk in his father’s office. Raizo was consumed with a feeling of joy, the pain he was inflicting was comforting.



His father’s exploits had finally caught up on him, although from an unlikely source. Like every runaway child, Raizo sought refuge, and he found it at a local underground pit fighting syndicate, where he was taken

in as a person to do small errands. 



He grew fond of the shootfighting that he was seeing, the vicious manner these warriors of the underground were doing battle. It had honour; it had everything his father had not. Raizo immediately began to train at a local ‘den’ learning his trade as a young fifteen year old, he began to train in every form of man to man combat the trainer knew. Mainly, suplex based, and power style fighting. His use of submissions intrigued Raizo, and he mastered several forms of submission moves.



His big break came… a fighter had dropped out from a main event show. Raizo, now standing an impressive 6’3, 257lbs, at the age of 23 began his shoot fighting career. He was an immediate success, defeating the then undefeated Yoki Yoshi in a record 3:01 minutes, with a superb technical display.



Life was looking up, Raizo made the life of a vagabond his own, he ventured from town to town, fighting fights, fighting for his own enjoyment, to gain respect from the masses He wanted to be feared…



It was at this time he discovered the Puroresu form of fighting, the concept intrigued him, as did the prospect of an established pay. He figured the idea to be worth looking into for full time employment, his

anger being fueled by the need to be respected, and for his father to know he is the better man.



Raizo Tenzan is a young man fueled by hate and rage… only time will tell if this anger ever spoils over into the ring.

tenures.bio:
Childhood





On the day of January 6, 1976 Jesse Ramey was born in Cabell-Hunington Hospital in Huntington, West Virginia. His parents are Nancy and Clarence Ramey. He was not the only child in the family. He has one older brother, Chris. Jesse grew up in a normal family. He had a lot of the things that he wanted and made fairly good grade through school, but was known as a problem child since the day he started Kindergarten. The teachers all knew that Jesse had problems and sent him to some therapists, but Jesse was always the smart child and kept from being put on any kind of drugs by acting like the nicest child in the world while he was around the therapists and lied through his teeth all the time. His parents weren't necessarily proud of the things that Jesse did through his grade school years in school and had to take him from one school to the other because of his being kicked out so much. Jesse had to be kept away from family members, male cousins, during grade school because of him always getting into fights with them. Didn't matter what side of the family they were on; he always held a grudge with them for one reason or another. Jesse almost all the time disobeyed his parents and would never do any kind of work what so ever around his house. His parents didn't know what to do with him so they just let him be, until the day they found an ad for a Boot Camp in Virginia. His parents felt that since he was in his 6th grade year of school that it was time for him to get something more out of life than just sitting around doing nothing and sent him to the boot camp. Jesse wasn't really happy with the decision, but did as he was told because he had two choices at the time. Go to the Boot Camp or be sent off to Juvenal Hall. Jesse was then sent to the boot camp where he learned a lot of basic skills and learns a lot of extreme things. Times were very hard for Jesse during this time and they made him work harder than he had ever done in his entire life. At time he had almost come close to dying and no one cared. He would be out in the middle of a field unconscious from working so hard and having no water, but no one would do anything. They just left him lay until he came to or if he died. Jesse struggled to get out the, as he called it, 'Hell Hole'. But finally on the day that he would have graduated from 9th grade he was allowed to leave the Boot Camp and return for home. Jesse had acquired the skills of being able to take orders, being built and being able to work all day with a limited supply of nutrients, he had a large variety of fighting techniques in his mind and he didn't talk as much. Jesse arrived to his home where his parents and brother awaited with open arms. Jesse was enrolled back into his old high school were they placed him in the upper level 10th grade class. None of his friends recognized Jesse when they first saw him because of how much he had changed in the three years of his absents. Jesse was kept in the higher classes all the way through his High School years. During his 11th year of High School Jesse was introduced to the sport of Professional Wrestling by some of his best friends. At the time they had got to go see the WCW live at the Charleston Civic Center. Jesse fell in love with the sport the first time he laid eyes on it. He was then determined to make his way to becoming a wrestler. Jesse turned 18 and then graduated in the year of '96 and keeps his dreams of becoming a Pro-Wrestler. 





College and First Indy League 





Jesse started college at West Virginia State College six months after he had graduated from High School and start to peruse his teaching degree in grade school level class. He did not forget his dreams of becoming a Pro-Wrestler, but he did want to think of things in the right direction. If he did not succeed as a Pro-Wrestler, he could always have the teaching degree to fall back on. Jesse made a 3.0 average his first semester of the college year and he also had his job on the side as wrestling for an Indy league promotion called the RHW (Rock Hard Wrestling). Jesse made it halfway through college and he had made a lot of fans through the RHW. He was much better than he thought he could ever be at wrestling. The promoter of the RHW also told Jesse that he was top quality and he didn't deserve to wrestle for the likes of an organization as the RHW, but Jesse would only shake his head and laugh at the sound of what was coming out of the promoter’s mouth. The time had come for the day of Jesse's college graduation and the promoter of the RHW had a little of a graduation gift in order for Jesse. He had gotten Jesse a contract to a largely known wrestling organization in Tokyo, Japan. Jesse was so thrilled that he didn't even pay any mind to what was enclosed in the contract and just signed to the deal. What Jesse didn't know was that he had just signed a contract for three years of wrestling at only one hundred dollars a match. After reading the whole contract Jesse was seriously pissed and want to just rip the contract into a million pieces, but he also learned that it was an ironclad contract and that there was no negotiating on him leaving. 





Japan and JWO (Japan Wrestling Organization)





On the day of July 30, 1998, Jesse got on a plane at the Charles Yeager Memorial Airport in Charleston, West Virginia. He had already started his career as a Japanese wrestle when he set foot on that plane. As soon as Jesse got seated on the plane he found out that he had been seated next to a man that had also fallen into the same trick that Jesse had been. The man went by the name of John Buchanan. Jesse and John hit it off from the start and decided that they would rather team together in the JWO than they would want the bookers to just place them with some Japanese crap wrestler. The two were on there long journey to the land of the rising sun and there was nothing much they could do about it. They were stuck in Japan for three years of worthless wrestling. Jesse and John arrived in Japan the next day and went to meet the promoter for JWO, but found out that he did not speak Japanese and neither did most of the wrestlers. This resulting Jesse and John losing a lot of matches and getting seriously injured all the time. Jesse and John regretted signing to those contracts without reading since the day the arrived in Japan, but regretted it even more after their first match. After about one year and a half Jesse and John were finally getting the hang of the native tongue and were actually winning a lot of matches. Sometimes even two or three a night. What they didn't know, but on December 27, 1998 a promoter for the UWL (Ultimate Wrestling League) from American had been in the crowd for a couple of their matches and had talked the JWO promoter into letting him take them back to America with him to wrestle for the UWL. Jesse and John were both very happy about this. 





UWL





On the day of their arrival into the UWL the two had learned that the UWL was a very big major federation in the states and that they had two televised shows a week and a monthly pay-per-view. They had given John the gimmick of being the wanna-be African-American named FUBU and they let him start wrestling the night after his contract signing. Jesse on the other hand was given a while off and in the process of this time off they were using him as a human genie pig on some new muscle enhancing pills that were supposed to be safe and non-addictive. The pills on the other hand did what they said, but they also made Jesse huge. He was even more pumped then what he was. He may have been huge, but he was only in the Lightweight Division. Jesse had finally been given a chance in the UWL and he was booked in a Television Title match right off the bat. What the bookers didn't know was that Jesse was to win the match and that he would become the Television Champion the first day he was on the show. Jesse went on to obtain the UWL Television Title on two separate occasions, the Tag Team Titles on one occasion with his former stable mate Blackheart, and he held the number one contender ship of the World Heavyweight Title, but on the night of his Title match the UWL had went bankrupt and could not afford to do anything, but cancel the show and close down the federation. Jesse was left with billions and no job. 





Time off, Crazy, and CWA





During most of 1999 Jesse was left without a job and had to stay in his little home located in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Jesse now calls Canada his home and only calls West Virginia his birthplace. Jesse was stuck in his little home with no job, no friends, no family and a little bit of a mind reaming. At one time he had threatened to take his own life and was sent to take calm down in a minimum security 'Nut House'. Jesse did not like the idea of this at all, but now he will say that it was worth it and that he needed to be looked away or he could have serious hurt himself. Jesse was released from the 'Nut House' on the day of April 16, 1999. He then was more determined then every to get back into the ring and found a home in the CWA (Championship Wrestling Alliance). There he stayed until the day that it closed. This brought him in even more millions and also helped him achieve the CWA Extreme Title on two separate occasions, brought him together with his friend John again and him and John held the Tag Team titles on one occasion and then Jesse went solo to claim his first World Heavyweight Title reign ever. After the night of Jesse winning the title the federation went under and shut down. It officially shut down on the day of October 30, 2000. 





JEW Days





On the day of December 17, 2000 Jesse makes his debut on live television once again. After being off of television and out of wrestling for almost 3 months he returns to wrestling and joins up with a new wrestling federation called Just Electrifying Wrestling, JEW for short. Not only did he make a big bang back into the sport, but it also was at a Pay-Per-View and it was the JEW's first. Jesse was signed under a six month contract with the JEW and plans to claim his own in it as in his short time there now he has formed a dominating group with long time friend John Buchanan aka Fubu and a new comer Thug roC, he has also made connections with JP Shire and has plans on taking out the JEW President and his White Blood goons. Jesse also won the JEW King of Extreme 2001 title at the January Pay-Per-View on the 21st. Time slowly goes by for Jesse here in the JEW, but it is also a prosperous time, he has gained the Cruiserweight Title in a match against, Thug roC and he also won the United States Heavyweight Title in a Over the Top Rope Elimination match. Plus the unthinkable happened, he turned on his loyal friends to go and become one of the President's lackeys, as a member of the White Bloods. On the night of February 13, 2001, Jesse tosses down both of his titles in hope of a shot at the JEW World Heavyweight Title somewhere down the road. The days of Jesse Ramey begin in the JEW were finally becoming numbered for this talented young star. On the site of the JEW's third Pay-Per-View, The Great American Nightmare, Jesse Ramey's friend Tod 'The 1 Man Army' Strastky made his debut and Jesse and Tod started to take control, during Tod's first JEW match he captured the Hardcore Title, but things started to go down hill for the two. Tod was placed in another match were he was forced to job to Psycho and lose the Hardcore Title. Afterwards the JEW creative team decided that Jesse and Tod were a bit to over rated and were not getting over with the fans, so they were pretty much just placed on a shelf until the day of March 29, 2001. On that day, the two were seen in New York City, N.Y. where they both ripped up their contracts and became Free Agents. 





CCW





Cyberspace Championship Wrestling seemed to be a great idea at the time of the JEW closing. Jesse was on a role with Fedwars and was getting into a very big Fedwars federation, but the worst only came. Jesse was slaking off. He was being beat by the worst in the business and wasn't even trying. His attitude in the ring was rubbing off on his 16 year old adopted daughter, Michelle Marie Ramey, and she herself joined with the CCW, and as said, she was also doing horrendous in the CCW, she had been in two Women's Title matches and lost in both. Jesse also has been in one Hardcore Title match and one Lightweight Title match, but he also lost in the two. Jesse has just recently re-signed a 150-day contract with CCW and hoping for the best. No titles had been won, but during a stint, Jesse had encountered a few new enemies in Phil Burner and his rogue Outlanders. In a way, Jesse was part of a turning point in the Outlanders rain of terror, no matter what anyone wants to think. Time has passed quickly in CCW. Not only did Fed Wars fold, but also in the process Jesse actually became popular. Joining the New Strangers stable. He fought alongside men that he could call friends, but trouble amongst the group occurred when Jesse wanted titles and the man standing in his way was Fenix, his stable mate, holding the Lightweight Title. Jesse won the Lightweight Title and then lost it to Fenix. Jesse then proceeded to take the Independent Title from Fenix and then lose it to Fenix once again. The stakes between the two were tied, until unfortunately, Fenix had to retire. Time went on and Jesse defected to a rogue heel stable, which he headed up, called The Lost Souls. Alongside Enigma, Jesse would go on to dominate most of CCW. The stable grows over a period of time, and Jesse, once again begins to go a little insane, or was it all part of his plan? Did he pretend to be insane only to come one step closer to his goal of being CCW Universal Champion? He lowered himself to actually compete in a Women's Title Evening Gown Match against Koriann, and actually come out on top, winning the Women's Title. After holding the title a short period of time, Jesse came to his senses and handed the title to his lover at the time, Damsel. After a stint as a cross-dresser and a failed Ladies' Man gimmick. Jesse was determined to get back on track, but that would all be cut short during his last PPV match in CCW. During the opening match against Blayze, Jesse was tosses off of a bridge by Commissioner Cianan. Jesse's body was never found and pronounced dead. RIP Jesse Ramey.



Exposure and the OSW



Jesse Ramey made his debut back into the Wrestling world on February 2nd, 2002 during the OSW Slam! Telecast. Many thought his being on the roster was a hoax, but Spider, the president of CCW had some heated things to say before the show went on the air, during the PTC Malice Radio Show. Saying that Jesse was a mere ingrate for doing this to CCW. Hinting that his return was indeed true. Jesse did in fact return during the first show, attacking former CCW rival Sebastian 'Switchblade' Toomes. The dreaded dress! Oh, yes, you heard that right. Not only did the rivalry between Toomes and Ramey continue, but also Toomes revealed Jesse's true weakness. The God-awful dress gimmick he was forced into playing out in CCW. The heated feud between these two men is continuing as the score is tied and looking to come to an end sometime soon, with the winner being the actual greater man. Time passes in the OSW and Brooklyn Born and Bred occurs. Jesse makes friends in Rhett Locke, Micheal Dame, and Scott Naket. The first OSW PPV comes soon, but how walks out the better man? Jesse Ramey or Tom Walczak? The PPV is long done, Michel Kreig made his debut to only cost Jesse his match and really, really piss Jesse off. After several weeks of going back and forth doing nothing with him-self, Jesse decided to take a stand, but was cut short by four masked men who have decided to make Jesse's OSW career a living hell. After finally revealing themselves as former CCW buddies, Jason McAllister, John Jupiter, Kensuke Suzahara, and Spider, a challenge was made for the PPV, Head on Collision and it was set to be a Street Fight. In the end, Team OSW came out victorious, but the mysterious I-Cybie caught Jesse's attention and sent him off into a deep dark alley, were the mysterious Vax character caught Jesse off guard with a couple ton of bricks from the air crushing Jesse and placing him on the injured list. When Jesse realized that OSW wasn't helping him and holding him back, he came to a decision that he wished to go back to Japan and train to come back full force in OSW, but spokesperson Shanda Russel didn't like the idea of this and shortly after an agreement was come to and Jesse was released from OSW and on the Wrestling Tattler free market.



FSW



Shortly after his firing, Jesse was approached by FSW representatives and was soon to be one of the first talents hired to the new Five Star Wrestling promotion. How will Jesse fair when Five Star Wrestling opens on July 1st, 2002? Going up against Ming and Asa Fountain on the opening FSW Glory card and what could be one of the greatest matches on the show, what could happen or be the out come of the match? After several weeks from the opening of FSW, things have begun to pick up pace, Jesse and Asa have found themselves being allies against a very unwilling team in Ming and Lo-Key. What does the road hold in store for the team of The Attitude and The Fro? After Lo-Key's departure from FSW and the introduction of an old rival of Jesse, the story continued with Bad Frotitude and the newly formed team of Michel Krieg and Ming. The aftermath of the first FSW PPV, Genesis, was nothing less than massive. Ming and Michel Krieg won the Tag Team gold and later on was challenged for the belts by the now number one contenders in Bad Frotitude. Once Bad Fro had gotten their chance at the Tag Team gold, an unknown two, who have been known as The Dead Presidents have been causing nothing, but havoc for both Ming and Krieg and Bad Fro. After many altercations and several weeks of painstakingly hard work, Bad Frotitude finally succeed in achieving their goal of holding the FSW World Tag Team Championship Titles and Jesse achieves his first actual piece of gold won in a Wrestling Tattler federation. The feud between Bad Frotitude and The Dead Presidents continues to heat up when Bad Moon Rising rolls around and everything is settled in a Tag Team Title Chain Match, or is it, when The Dead Presidents win the Tag Team Titles in a obvious display of cheating and also reveal themselves as the former PCW Tag Team Champions, Politically Incorrect. PI forms an alliance with the defunct Big Daveylicious and now turned Magnum Wolf to create The Court, leaving Bad Frotitude at a distinct disadvantage until former CCW Tag Team Champions, Jason McAllister and John Jupiter, reform the great Last Rites, but even then not all is right with things as Jesse once had a bitter past with the two and this spells trouble for everything as The Court continues their reign of terror in FSW. Abruptly things come to a close between Jesse Ramey and FSW as he is released from his contract for reasons that are unknown and will most likely never be known.



PWA, The Move, and PURE



After being let go by Five Star Wrestling and then several weeks later being asked to go to the Primetime Wrestling Academy to hone his wrestling abilities, Jesse was contacted by the new owner of the Puro based wrestling federation within the WT, amply titled PURE, in it’s now third run. Although several things had to happen in Jesse’s life to make all of this happen. One of the major things was having to leave all of his family and friends back in the United States as he seeks residency in Japan. After spending several weeks with his family and friends, Jesse got the word that he would be able to find some residency in the town of Mito, Japan. Jesse has been located there now for several weeks and is slowly beginning to work things out in PURE and the backstage area for the new opening, which should be amazing to say the least. After the first week of PURE, the heat is beginning to rise between 'Sinister' Steven Lee and Jesse, after a controversial win over Ramey, only more heat can come as the weeks progress. Everything came to a head at the first ever PURE PPV entitled Final Destinies when Steven Lee and Ramey fought to see who would continue on into the night to face the winner of the Enmity and Eddie Mandrake match to crown the first ever PURE Heavyweight Champion. Eddie beat Enmity and as soon as Jesse beat Steven Lee in a brutal match, Eddie came to the ring and in what could be claimed the best match of the year for PURE Jesse claimed victory over his friend Eddie to become the first ever PURE Heavyweight Champion, but with the brand extensions and Jesse now being a part of the PURE: World, who will stand up to take the challenge and try to take the championship away from him?

S2 holds both of their legs and drops down, driving the opponent face first into the mat./) *-=3=- 'Ultima Suicida' (Sabu's Triple Jump Suicida) - (\ S2 vaults from the ring, to a chair, to the rope, and leaps at his opponent, usually through a table./) * = Performed either with Extreme or Regular match resume` History: Cordozer 'S2' Stevenson is one of the most gifted, well-rounded, and unpredictable wrestlers of our time. Still at the bright young age of nineteen, he's been tucked away by Dante Jackson, and is maybe one of the youngest stars on the Japanese circuit today. The problem is, he can do just about anything just to please the fans. Whether it be from jumping thirty feet to the crowd below, or wrestling one of the most scientific PURE matches, he can do it all. His style tends to focus mainly on keeping his opponent on their toes, catching them off guard with his unorthodox wrestling throws and holds while quietly positioning the opponent to catch them off guard with his spectacular and devastating Endless Waltz . His style meshes well with any other style, and he can often work with several different styles, himself. This makes S2 one of the most respectable wrestlers in the market, today. No wonder when he snagged gold at the 2001 X Games, after pulling a Coffin Heelkicker that people started calling him Suicidal. Cordozer 'S2' Stevenson is a well defined high flyer who is usually seen with a pair of silver shorts with the ends coming down past his kneecaps and coming close to his ankles. A circular spiked belt is wrapped around his shorts, as he wears a pair of Timberland Chukka Boots. He wears no shirt, showing his Crusierweight/Lightweight physique and multiple Japanese tattoos thanks to his ten years up bringing in Japan. Stevenson is viewed by some in the community as a sex symbol, for his good looks, and bad boy behavior. He is knowing of the Puroresu style, from various watchings of New Japan, and working the 2001 Super J Cup, finishing third. Stevenson was brought up with a background in America, as well as Japan thanks to his descent. He is 1/3 African American, 1/3 Caucasian, and 1/3 Asian. By adulthood, Stevenson had become one of the more sought after talents in sports after his longevity in the Moto X circuit. By the turn of 1998, Stevenson, barely even in his teens had grown fond of the sport of Motocross, and signed up beyond the signing age to appear in the 98' X Games in which he finished beyond his years and it earned him two gold medals and one silver. By 99', he had overcome every obstacle and was one of the star attractions, sweeping his events and winning gold. America and magazines were smitten with Stevenson. After gracing the covers of the majority of extreme sport magazines, S2 ventured over into Japan, enventually coming back towards his roots in Puroresu wrestling.Without telling nay a soul, he dawned a mask, calling himself Black Dragon and compeiting in the New Japan Pro circuit, winning the Jr. Heavyweight tournament and competiting in some of the better matches of the year. Switching over to FMV later in the year, Steveson began to show the nature of a Xtreme star, that same commodity he had in America. He began to compete in extreme matches, showing off his nature of brutality and bringing FMV into a national powerhouse in Japan. Skipping the X Games for the year 2000, Stevenson continued to stay in Japan and continue his training, almost being silent and away from his sport for a year. He came back to American in May of 2002, running into his now friend Dante Jackson during the Making A Star contest, running on MTV. The two of them grew mutual respect for one another, before Stevenson told Jackson that he was going to Japan once more, dropping the moniker Black Dragon and calling himself Suicidal Stevenson, or S2 for short. He's back in Japan, and out for another extreme show, like he says, 'Putting your body on the line, your life just for the fans is apart of this business. I may not be the biggest, or the smallest but I am the main reason people come to our shows.'

tenures.bio:
The Riven family is where everything begins for Andrew Riven. Andrew’s father, grandfather and great grandfather where all apart of All Canadian Wrestling, Canada’s top ranked wrestling promotion. They had passed the business down through the family. Everyone was involved someway form managing, wrestling, refereeing or even doing backstage work, every member of the Riven family was apart of the industry. The three old Riven’s though where all very big men. Each coming in over 275lbs each and they all used the same technical skills passed down to them. They where brawlers and mat technicians. But that was the end off the common bonds. 



Andrew Scott Riven was born to Lisa Smith-Riven and Alex Karl-Riven. Alex being a wrestler much like his father John and his father Scott was happy to have a soon he could bring up into his own eyes much like the rest of the family did. By age three Andrew was already starting to begin his training with his father. Doing the simple running and small weight lifting. By age seven Andrew had began to learn how to fall correctly on the mat and learn the basic moves. All three generations before Andrew helped out as they where all excited to push him farther. Andrew didn’t complain because he wanted to continue the family business. 



By age eleven problems began to form. Andrew couldn’t do the more powerful moves that his family want him to do and they all learn before and he couldn’t attempt any powerful ground moves with risking injury. Emotion’s starts to rise as Andrew had the wait of his family on his shoulder’s pushing him to move quickly. But all this was getting to Andrew and at age twelve he broke down. He couldn’t work anymore with his family. His father would constantly talk to him and encourage him back into the ring but the system was not right for Andrew. He continually told his family he was to small to perform and be a power wrestler. That’s when the Riven’s decided it was time for the chain to be broken and Andrew would have to train somewhere else. Knowing Andrew would have to start all over again if he went to a normal school in Canada or the United states, Andrew was sent down to Tijuana, Mexico famous for training wrestlers in the art of Lucha Libre. The whole Riven house hold got up and left Sarnia and moved down to Mexico so Andrew would have family near by and so the rest of the family could be an active role in his life. 



Private training began and Andrew learned at a normal rate. His teacher worked with him everyday and went over every key step. Andrew was finally happy he had found a style he could enjoy. By the age of twenty and spending eight years mastering his talent down to an art Andrew finally received his mask from his teach as a gift. He still wears the mask today. Andrew and the whole Riven family spent another year in Mexico so Andrew could spend time with other Luchadors but later on moved back up to Canada so Andrew could continue with the family business and join All Canadian Wrestling. 



Andrew became a huge talent and an entertainer larger then most. He was scouted but never signed and spent most in the crusierweight division, which was fine with Andrew. Classified as one of Canada’s only and best Lucha masters Andrew every day tries to impress the Canadian audience. But he is looking for a global view now and sets his eyes on PURE. He style maybe be different and maybe be small but Andrew has learned one thing from the generations before him and that is to entertain the fans.

"Just because I am small doesn't mean I can't entertain."
"Tema el Luchador "

tenures.bio:
Shaun Styles was born in Brooklyn, NY. His life was filled with hardships that he had to overcome to get where he is at today. When he was born his father left the family to get himself another bitch to knock up and leave. Life was hard for Styles as a kid growing up without a father but he managed. 







Things seemed to just keep on getting worse and worse and worse. At the age of eight his mother died of cancer. Now he had no place to go and nothing to look forward to. 







Styles ended up moving in with his grandparents who were less than thrilled to take care of him and raise him. This is why it was so uncomfortable living there for such a long time. He did not get much of an education and could not afford to go to college. When he reached the age of 18 his grandparents told him to find his own life and stop expecting everybody to help him. With that said Shaun Styles was off on his own again and once again did not have a single clue of what to do. 







In the end Styles decided to collect all of the money he had saved from working half assed jobs and decided to go around the world to find his niche. After a while of traveling he had returned with a newfound talent: Fighting. That seemed to be the only thing he's good at.







This 'skill' was discovered in China during his journey. He ended up in a fight with a mechanic over car problems, which led to a dispute. The fight ended in a KO. Shaun took the well-built man out without taking a punch. Jade Taylor was in the crowd during the fight. He saw what went down and offered Shaun a job. A job to be a boxer. 







No it wasn't professional but it paid very well nonetheless. Jade Taylor was running an underground boxing promotion. Every once in a while a fair amount of people would meet, bet, and witness a boxing match. This was the business that Shaun Styles was involved in now. Jade Taylor and him grew to become very good friends. The best of. 







His success all came down to one fight. Shaun Styles vs. J.T. Thunder. Jade Taylor was in discussions with the opponent for several nights before the match and they have come up with an agreement. J.T. Thunder was supposed to take the fall. Shaun Styles and Jade Taylor chose a select few and told them of this lucrative proposition. The main man they came to was Don Laproni, the head of the Laproni family. A very dangerous man. They had promised him that this was a very safe investment. He believed them. Everything just went downhill after that. J.T. Thunder broke the deal. Shaun Styles was knocked out in the first round. That was the end of his career. It might even be the end of his life. 







So here he is now, a young man of 21, completely broke, and in debt to some very dangerous people. What do you do? ...You wrestle.

"Wrestling? What the hell is that?"
"You think you're good? You're not. I'm good. Yeah, that sounds about right."
"Yeah...I'll beat you...I guess"

Deep Impact (Faithful Youth power bombs his opponent into the turnbuckle instead of the mat) Regret (A Jackhammer from the top turnbuckle) The Inspiration (Opponent is placed into a reverse DDT position but then spun around as Faithful Youth drops his back onto the mat and his opponents head hits his shoulder.)
tenures.bio:
Born on July 12, 1980 Andrew Riven or better known as Faithful Youth made his first appearance into the world. Coming from a small Canadian city, Andrew was different in many different ways. For starters he was very strong and powerful kid. He also was very intelligent and so when he did well in school other students wouldn’t dare touch him for they didn’t want to talk with Andrew.



Andrew began to lift weights, run long distances, and train every day for something. His parents didn’t know what he was trying to become. His parents where normal people. His father and mother both worked and life went normal. 



Andrew’s inside life was a different story. He hated talking to people. He was very shy, and would get very nervous in front of large groups of people. His teachers suggest he write down his feelings on paper and communicate that way. It worked. He started off writing just normal sentences but later on wrote poetry, stories and even songs to show how he felt. 



At the age of 10, Andrew had his first poem published in a book. That was latter followed on by his own book of poems, a novel and a bunch of songs for local-city bands. But the good times would soon turn into dark times. The family went through financial troubles and was just getting by on what they had. Andrew had to do something. 



Knowing that money could be made as a writer he set out to create his own line of poetry books. Knowing that he would be taken seriously at the age of 12, Andrew created a second identity. It was then that Faithful Youth was born. Faithful for his faith in him self and youth because he was still a kid. 



He started writing and he spent all his free time making this big. By the age of 13 Faithful Youth’s first poetry book was on sale. Andrew made over $50,000 in the first year with the book. All that money went to his family. 



Andrew was still get stronger on the outside as well on the inside. By the age of 14 he was 200 pounds of pure power. He never hurt anyone but he just trained to build up a package in himself that would be unbeatable. 



At 16 the family was doing well. But it wouldn’t last long. Andrew needed something else. Looking at his size and strength the best choice would be either boxing or wrestling. He didn’t care for boxing as it had very little moves to remember. So he choice wrestling and all the money he made was sent back to his parents. 



So Andrew with no money for himself did the only other thing he knew how to do and that was write. After six years of wrestling in the Canadian circuit he stopped. His parents where more then grateful and offered money to Andrew. He didn’t take it saying that was for them. 



At age 21 Faithful Youth came back into the world. He put out his third poetry book and did a world tour promoting it. He still had some fear of standing in front of people but that was quickly overcome by reading his work to the people in the audience and 6 years of wrestling. 



But now at the age of 23, Faithful Youth wants to make the move from writing back into wrestling. The money was fine in writing but the excitement was almost gone. He now had one goal in mind. He was a major person in the writing industry but he didn’t want the years of his training to go to waist. He sets his eyes now on wrestling so he can once again amaze an audience only this time not with his words but with his actions.
catchphrases: "Be faithful of your own work first before you have faith in someone elses."

tenures.bio:
Of modest beginnings and decidedly mixed heritage, Senji Powers was born on the Japanese island of Okinawa to a Japanese mother and a retired American soldier living in Japan with his teenaged son and infant daughter. From the start Senji proved a handful as he ran amock and monopolized his parent's time, to the chagrin of his older half sister Alicia. Senji would learn a sobering lesson later as he learned not everyone was so accepting of his mixed heritage and western ways. Senji would retreat further and further from his family… until he finally disowned them completely. Senji reaffirmed his Japanese culture and embraced it… perhaps a bit too tightly. None the less… Senji took his family name of Yulav and left his mother's house when he was barely in his teens. Senji made his own way for a while… but having little or no job skills made things difficult… but his luck would soon change when his sister came calling with an offer that was too good to pass up on. 

Alicia Sinn sought out her brother after acquiring her own company and the immense wealth that came with it. Senji… though slow to embrace what he called his 'Gajin' sister… chose to join her nonetheless. In time Senji became quite the inspiring young talent in the ring… though he preferred the no-holds barred style. Senji enjoyed moderate success inside the ring… but his true love of the martial arts was all consuming. Senji dropped off the map after studying many styles in an attempt to create his own. Apparently having achieved his goal… Senji has returned with the hopes of staking claim to championship gold… to prove the superiority of the martial arts and the Japanese culture. 

Senji is arrogant and pompous. Believing that no person… man or woman is the equal of the Japanese. Senji borders on being a racial militant in his obsession to prove himself superior to all others. Deep down… Senji is deeply disturbed and sickened by the impurity of his own blood and he sometimes takes his cause to the extreme in an attempt to abate that very fact. For Senji… honor is everything… but his methods sometimes prove the contrary. 

Small in size for a wrestler, Senji is however powerfully built. His frame is wrapped in a layer of pure muscle that is a testament to his intense training. Senji's mixed heritage is painfully obvious in his appearance, much like his sister. Senji has coal black hair and a light complexion. He's rather clean cut, with little or no facial hair.
catchphrases:
"Do you know how it feels to be unwanted? To be an outlaw, not just from one place but universally? No I didnt think so."
"Stupid Useless American"

Appearance:

Head:

Dark blue eye (note he is missing his right eye), Strong oriental features (Think Jubei Yagyuu from Ninja Resurrection) Long black hair pulled into a pony tail



Body:

Small Frame packed with muscle but built for speed (Think Jet Li or Nicholas Tse here)



Attire:

Out of Ring - Black expensive suits sometimes coatless with a white button up shirts



In Ring

Same Dress slacks only shirtless



Entrance:

Tomodachi by Ketsumeishi kicks in as Shin Yagyuu appears at the entrance with black angel wings straped to his back.. The lights cut out and strobes kick in as Yagyuu runs to the ring and slides in..



History:

Born in Kobe, Japan Shin Yagyuu was trained from age five to be a machine of destruction. At 15 his father through him out of their home after Shin had stolen a loaf of bread for lunch. His father claimed Shin a disgrace to the legendary Yagyuu name. Next calling him Jubei reincarnated his father cut his own sons eye out. Shin left his home and family finding himself in multiple places over the next five years of his life. At twenty he fell in with the Yakuza and became their killing machine. During a job following his 21st birthday Shin was left behind during an assassination. Taking his opprtunity he fled to his hometown of Kobe... Where a wrestling scout picked him up for PURE
